A '''Protein cake''' was a type of cake.<ref name="MotC">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]] was supping on protein cakes and [[Tea/Legends|tea]] when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] burst into her chambers and informed Veda of his suspicions that she was being poisoned.<ref name="MotC" />
